fusions.name: Quiet Deposition
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 20 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. It has 40% more critical chance against an enemy that has not yet bled. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Drawn Under the Robe
fusions.desc: A slash that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaves each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Out of the Light
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds, and you move 20% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Blade Kept Sheathed
fusions.desc: When you have gone a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
